body.x: Blade Electronics(www.blade-electronics.com), a developer of cutting edge tech products with an emphasis on mobility and premium design, unveiled pulsepak at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.PulsePak is a tiny battery pack that can be used in cases where there is no access to a conventional charger. PulsePak is roughly the size of 2 ½ sticks of chewing gum and there is a metal ring attached to it so it can be used as a keychain. It is available in two versions: iPhone's lightning connector and Micro USB. PulsePak will extend the battery life on most phones long enough to allow the user to talk on the phone for an extra two hours.
